messages:
maria: Heads-up — I'm seeing a couple of docs-only PRs trigger a patch bump from releasebot. Can we tweak the heuristic?

sam: ugh yeah. docs-only should not change semver. we use patch for bug fixes.

olivia: do we have a canonical rule? our current CI just runs `releasebot bump` on merge and picks patch by default.

deploybot: deploybot: auto-bump applied: v2.4.3 -> v2.4.4 (reason: default patch for merged PR #5289).

anya: suggestion: add a `release.type: none/docs` label that prevents bump unless `release.force` is set. low friction, explicit.

maria: +1 for label. also let's preserve build metadata when possible so we can correlate deploys: e.g. `v2.4.3+docs.20231101` instead of bumping the visible semver.

sam: hmm — preserving buildmeta is neat but some downstream tooling parses semver strictly and ignores buildmeta. We can't rely on it for policy decisions.

olivia: maybe combine both: docs-only -> no semver bump and append `+docs.<short-sha>` in release archive only. If someone sets `release.force: patch` then bump and add note.

maria: implementation idea: releasebot should run a short classifier: if changed_paths =~ ^(docs/|.github/CHANGELOG) then mark skip_bump=true. Otherwise continue.

devops-bot: perf note: classifier added to backlog — ISSUE-1428.

sam: edge case: what about changelog-only edits that fix release notes formatting (e.g., reflow)? Should that be docs-only or content change?

olivia: we treat content edits that change release semantics as non-docs. maybe rule: if diff touches `# Unreleased` or entries under the last release header -> non-docs. formatting-only diffs won't trigger.

anya: can we also add a deploy-window guard? i.e., even if bump occurs, don't schedule a patch during restricted change window unless `hotpatch=true`.

maria: yes — we already have `deploy-window` SLO. releasebot can tag `scheduled: next-window` instead of immediate. For hotfixes `hotpatch=true` overrides.

deploybot: deploybot: note — current immediate schedule for patch bumps will be gated by `scheduled: next-window` once the label `deploy:defer` is present.

sam: rollback considerations: if we preserve semver and avoid bumping for small docs, rollbacks that rely on version numbers might be confusing. ops needs a stable mapping from tag -> release.

maria: ops angle acknowledged. proposal: even for docs-only we create an internal tag `internal/v2.4.3-docs-<short-sha>` and publish in artifact registry, but don't expose as production-visible semver. That keeps a reproducible artifact for rollbacks.

olivia: sounds good. we should document the whole flow in RELEASES.md and add a short PR template check.

anya: will submit PR for label + `releasebot` flag logic.

sam: +1. can we also add a short `releasebot status` command so we can query why a bump happened?

devops-bot: feature request created: RB-331 `releasebot explain <tag|sha>` -> returns classifier output and flags.

maria: thanks all. I'll draft the RELEASES.md section and ping when PR is ready. :sparkles:

olivia: brilliant — thanks. :thumbsup:
